shortDescription: Manage site-local EPG domains in schema template

options.name: allow_micro_segmentation
options.description: Specifies microsegmentation is enabled or not. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: allow_promiscuous
options.description: The allow promiscuous state of the domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: anp
options.description: The name of the ANP.

options.name: binding_type
options.description: Which binding_type to use with this domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: custom_epg_name
options.description: Which custom_epg_name to use with this domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: delimiter
options.description: Which delimiter to use with this domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: deployment_immediacy
options.description: The deployment immediacy of the domain. C(immediate) means B(Deploy immediate). C(lazy) means B(deploy on demand).

options.name: domain_association_type
options.description: The type of domain to associate.

options.name: domain_profile
options.description: The domain profile name.

options.name: enhanced_lagpolicy_dn
options.description: Distinguished name of EPG lagpolicy. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: enhanced_lagpolicy_name
options.description: EPG enhanced lagpolicy name. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: epg
options.description: The name of the EPG.

options.name: forged_transmits
options.description: The forged transmits state of the domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: host
options.description: IP Address or hostname of the ACI Multi Site Orchestrator host. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: login_domain
options.description: The login domain name to use for authentication. The default value is Local. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_LOGIN_DOMAIN) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_login_domain) will be used if this attribute is not specified.

options.name: mac_changes
options.description: The mac changes state of the domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: micro_seg_vlan
options.description: Virtual LAN for microsegmentation. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: micro_seg_vlan_type
options.description: Virtual LAN type for microsegmentation. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: netflow_pref
options.description: The netflow preference state of the domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: num_ports
options.description: Number of ports for the binding type. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: output_level
options.description: Influence the output of this MSO module. C(normal) means the standard output, incl. C(current) dict C(info) adds informational output, incl. C(previous), C(proposed) and C(sent) dicts C(debug) adds debugging output, incl. C(filter_string), C(method), C(response), C(status) and C(url) information If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_OUTPUT_LEVEL) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_PASSWORD) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for the REST connection. The default value depends on parameter `use_ssl`. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: port_allocation
options.description: Port allocation for the binding type. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association and binding type in static. Required when O(binding_type=static).

options.name: port_encap_vlan
options.description: Virtual LAN type for port encap. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: port_encap_vlan_type
options.description: Virtual LAN type for port encap. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: resolution_immediacy
options.description: Determines when the policies should be resolved and available. Defaults to C(lazy) when unset during creation.

options.name: schema
options.description: The name of the schema.

options.name: site
options.description: The name of the site.

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing. Use C(query) for listing an object or multiple objects.

options.name: switch_type
options.description: Which switch type to use with this domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: switching_mode
options.description: Which switching mode to use with this domain association. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.

options.name: template
options.description: The name of the template.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds. The default value is 30 seconds. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_TIMEOUT) will be used instead.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_PROXY) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(false), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_USE_SSL) will be used instead. When using a HTTPAPI connection plugin the inventory variable C(ansible_httpapi_use_ssl) will be used if this attribute is not specified. The default is C(false) when using a HTTPAPI connection plugin (mso or nd) and C(true) when using the legacy connection method (only for mso).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to use for authentication. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variables C(MSO_USERNAME) or C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(MSO_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead. The default is C(true).

options.name: vlan_encap_mode
options.description: Which VLAN enacap mode to use. This attribute can only be used with VMM domain association.
